companies.name: Jio Platforms
companies.what_they_did: Launched an astrology platform called JioAstro to generate birth charts and personalised insights using advanced AI trained in Vedic astrology. Took the platform offline shortly after it became publicly accessible, stating it was a demo survey.
companies.story: Jio Platforms forayed into the online astrology market with the launch of a dedicated offering called JioAstro. Hours after becoming publicly accessible, the platform was taken offline. Sources stated that the platform was being tested privately and was not supposed to be released publicly.
reasons: The platform was taken offline after hours of public accessibility.
Sources stated it was being tested privately and was not supposed to be realised publicly.
companies.one_line: The platform was a demo survey and was taken offline because it was only meant for private testing.
